newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU industrial capacity rate highest since early '96.
newsitem.headline: EU industrial capacity rate highest since early '96.

text.p: Industrial capacity in the European Union rose to 81.6 percent in April, its highest level since the early part of 1996, the European Commission said on Friday.
The latest result put the industrial measure just slightly below its long-term average of 81.9 percent and a full point over the level seen in the first quarter of this year.
The European Commission also said a majority of manufacturing managers "observed an increase in new orders" and were optimistic that exports would continue to rise.
Separately, a Commission survey of consumer sentiment showed that confidence remained high.
